cases.title: Create a notes application from an empty workspace
cases.brief: Build a runnable notes application with a browser UI, HTTP API, SQLite storage, migrations, validation, automated tests and a README containing exact run commands.
criteria: A user can create, edit, list and delete notes from the UI
A clean checkout starts using the documented commands

cases.title: Add a large feature to an existing project
cases.brief: Add export/import of Agent Hub quest history, including API, persistence, UI, tests, migration compatibility and documentation without changing unrelated modules.
criteria: Export is deterministic and redacts credentials
Import validates schema and cannot cross workspace boundaries
UI reports conflicts and validation errors
Full repository tests and extension build pass
faults: parallel agents edit the same integration file

cases.title: PHP Composer Symfony application from public Git URL
cases.brief: URL intake of a PHP 8.3 Composer/Symfony repository: implement both endpoints, tax number formats, percentage and fixed coupons, unknown products/coupons/processors, payment errors, control total 116.56, run PHPUnit and HTTP scenarios from a clean final branch.
criteria: Repository is obtained only from the HTTPS URL
Environment detects PHP 8.3, Symfony, Composer and Docker
Four tax number formats are verified
Percentage and fixed coupons are verified
Unknown products, coupons and processors are verified
Clean checkout of the final branch reproduces the result
No false completed status without EvidenceBundle

cases.title: Cross-module change in an existing Go project
cases.brief: Make a coordinated change across two Go packages with shared contracts and tests.

cases.title: Node application with API, database and UI
cases.brief: Extend or build a Node app covering API, persistence and a small UI with tests.

cases.title: Python project with migration and tests
cases.brief: Apply a data migration and keep automated tests green.

cases.title: Greenfield workspace from a DOCX/PDF specification
cases.brief: Create a new project from an attached DOCX/PDF brief without an existing repository.
criteria: Workspace is created empty of prior git history
Acceptance criteria from the document are machine or manual

cases.title: Repository with a broken Dockerfile
cases.brief: Detect a failing project Dockerfile, repair the environment stage, then continue the task.
criteria: Managed fallback or fixed Dockerfile works

cases.title: Unknown stack with temporary runtime adapter
cases.brief: Generate and probe a RuntimeSpec adapter for an unrecognized stack before execution.
criteria: Temporary adapter is bound to the quest lease

cases.title: Parallel authors with a merge conflict
cases.brief: Two worktrees edit the same file; merge coordinator routes the conflict to an integration agent.

cases.title: Hub restart during execution
cases.brief: Interrupt the Hub mid-run and recover from checkpoint without inventing success.

cases.title: Forbidden network and contract expansion
cases.brief: A new domain is denied until the intake contract is expanded and re-approved.
